origine_fr: L'eau 氵 et 骨, qui donnait le son ; lu gǔ, il ne donne plus celui de huá. 滑, c'est lisse, ce qui glisse. L'eau rend tout glissant.
origine_en: Water 氵 and 骨, which gave the sound; read gǔ, it no longer matches huá. 滑 means smooth, slippery. Water makes everything slippery.

phrase.pinyin: Xià xuě le, lù hěn huá.
phrase.fr: Il a neigé, la route est glissante.
phrase.en: It's snowed and the road is slippery.
